Package io.telekom.orchest.api.core.adapters.data.repository

Interface UserTaskRepository

public interface UserTaskRepository
Repository interface for managing User Task instances. Provides methods to create, query, update, and delete user tasks throughout their lifecycle (CREATED → CLAIMED → COMPLETED).

    • findAvailableForUser

      List<UserTaskInstance> findAvailableForUser(String userId, List<String> userGroups)
      Finds all active user tasks where the user is a candidate (directly or via groups). Returns tasks in CREATED state where: - The user is in candidateUsers, OR - Any of the user's groups matches candidateGroups, OR - The user is the assignee
      Parameters:
      userId - The user identifier.
      userGroups - The groups the user belongs to.
      Returns:
      List of user tasks available to the user.

    • findByProcessInstanceIdAndActivityId

      Optional<UserTaskInstance> findByProcessInstanceIdAndActivityId(String processInstanceId, String activityId)
      Finds a user task by process instance ID and activity ID. Used internally when completing a user task via the engine.
      Parameters:
      processInstanceId - The process instance ID.
      activityId - The BPMN activity/node ID.
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the user task, or empty if not found.
